prompts: Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is a two-panel technical crop of the EXACT official Phoenix Reffaella eyes, the left crop and right crop are intentionally asymmetric. It is the edit target. Change ONLY the colored iris/pupil regions INSIDE each eye to clean eye-white sclera matching each existing eye's white and light blue-gray shading. Remove all golden/orange/purple colored iris, pupil, and iris highlights in those regions. Preserve every original pixel outside the iris regions as closely as possible: the eye opening shape, upper and lower eyelash geometry, eyelids, original tilt and asymmetry, face skin, eyebrows and hair must remain unchanged. Do NOT enlarge, round, redraw or restyle these eyes, do not make them symmetrical, and do not rearrange the two panels. Keep the exact same two side-by-side crops and framing. There should be zero iris or pupil left in either eye. No text, no watermark. This is a white-eye underlay asset for independently moving the original iris sprites; not a finished facial expression. Preserve original alpha where present.

Precise cleanup of the provided eye-white underlay image. Keep the two panels, framing, face, hair and OUTER eyelash/eyelid contours unchanged. INSIDE the eye whites there are still black or dark U-shaped vertical/curved lines that used to be the boundaries of the removed irises. Remove ALL of these internal iris-outline remnants in both eyes. The entire interior of each eye must be one uninterrupted clean white/light blue-gray sclera surface with matching subtle shading: absolutely no black curves, no ring, no pupil, no iris, no internal marks. Preserve only the outer lash border at the edges of the eye opening. Do not redraw the whole eyes or change their original asymmetric shapes. This is a technical empty eye-white texture. Keep exact composition, no text, no watermark.
source: Original official eye crops; no restyling. Only generated eye-white interior underlays used.
status: Recorded local official-pixel-preserving authoring recipe. Neither its official reference image nor its generated underlay is redistributed.
